profile.headline: Engineering Tech Lead @ Apple | Machine Learning Experimentation | Ads Delivery | Purdue University | Indian Institute of Technology Madras
profile.summary: Innovative and results-driven Engineering Technology Leader with a strong track record in strategic planning, execution, and building complex systems with over a decade of experience. Specializes in ad serving technologies, experimentation and machine learning platforms, recognized for leading initiatives that drive high impact results and pioneering solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Engineering Tech Lead
positions.description:
Architect & develop experimentation platform for ad platform
▪ Led the design and implementation of multi-layer experimentation in partnership with product teams and data scientists, resulting in a 3X increase in experimentation capacity 
▪ Spearheaded the design and development of Apple Ads'  ML Experimentation Platform, driving innovation in machine learning testing and optimization.
▪ Designed and implemented a privacy-first architecture, integrating innovative privacy-preserving techniques to enhance data security and compliance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Architected app blacklisting flow by optimizing scanning logic with caching, thus expanding system’s coverage for over 50 countries, significantly reducing the processing time by 97% (from a week to 4 hours)
▪ Redesigned the entire microservices backend, using change capture and streaming, resulting in a 10x reduction in messages and resolving synchronization issues for advertisers
▪ Engineered a high-performance index-building pipeline by integrating advertiser campaigns with algorithmic scores, and enabled up to 50 index-based experiments
▪ Designed an inference engine to enable prediction improvements by supporting tree models within Ad Serving stack

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Built a stats framework to provide visibility and monitor index building pipelines, which was adopted by SRE for ongoing use.
▪ Developed and managed backend services for the ad server, processing millions of daily requests and integrating machine learning models

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Built a database-exploration based test framework to generate over 25,000 cases to extensively verify the security model of java beans.
▪ Developed and deployed ‘sparse field-sets’ end-to-end feature in Java and JavaScript for web service platforms, thereby reducing the query response times by over 20 percent. 
▪ Created a data schema and updated the database and web service to integrate 4 new partners into the mobile data analytics platform.

positions.title: Interim Engineering Intern - Wireless Firmware Team
positions.description:
▪ Developed a demodulation back-end profiling script using Python and identified a 5 percent sub-frame loading time between the busy and idle slots. 
▪ Implemented a non-linear interference cancellation algorithm C++ and Vector Processor DSP for low cost wireless modems using 6 percent of the cycle time to boost the output signal strength by up to 6 dBm.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Designed and implemented a record and playback prototype using Java and Selenium, reducing the defect filing time by 20 percent.
▪ Developed an automation tool using Java with on the fly object recognition and a simple tokenized language, leading to a 2x increase in the automation productivity.
▪ Led the code coverage and quality initiatives across Cisco Services by working across cods-functional teams with presentations and demos, and thereby increasing the coverage rates by 30 percent.

positions.title: Intern - Network Engineer
positions.description: ▪ Developed an algorithm in Java and discovered the routers and the links between them using the SNMP entries of OSPF routing protocol for real-time network monitoring and failure analysis.

projects.title: Compiler
projects.description:
Language & Tools: ANTLR, Java
.Generate scanner and parser for C like Micro language
.Process variable declaration and Create symbol tables, build semantic routines
.Use liveness analysis as optimization strategy
.Executable 4 register simulator

projects.title: Operating Systems
projects.description:
●	Developed a device driver for a PCI-based Intel 82545EM Ethernet Adapter in Xinu (a simplistic Operating System) and verified it using a minimal network stack for TCP and UDP.
●	Implemented a two-level process scheduler to avoid starvation of processes and to improve CPU load-balancing among I/O and CPU bound processes.
